projects.title: FTTH Billing System
projects.description: Enterprise billing platform supporting products, pricing, promotions, discounts, vouchers, subscribers and billing APIs.
projects.longDescription: An enterprise Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) billing platform built to support the full subscriber lifecycle: product catalog, pricing plans, promotions, discounts, vouchers, subscriber management and invoicing through REST APIs. The system is designed as a set of collaborating services with clear boundaries so that billing, subscriber management and product configuration can evolve independently. The API surface is REST-based and consumed by internal portals and partner integrations. The platform emphasizes correctness of money handling, auditability of pricing changes and reliable invoicing workflows.
highlights: Product catalog with pricing plans and promotion rules
Subscriber lifecycle including activation, suspension and termination
Voucher and discount engine exposed through REST APIs
Auditable billing runs with stable money handling
responsibilities: Designed and implemented REST APIs for subscriber and billing management
Modeled pricing, promotions and discounts with extensibility in mind
Built voucher support and validation rules
Ensured auditability of billing changes

projects.title: Stock Exchange System (Modification)
projects.description: Modification and enhancement of an existing Stock Exchange System, focusing on business functionality, system behavior, integrations and maintainability.
projects.longDescription: A modification and enhancement engagement on an existing Stock Exchange System. The work focused on improving business functionality, system behavior, integrations and maintainability rather than a greenfield rewrite. Changes were introduced incrementally and validated against existing behavior to avoid regressions in a sensitive domain where correctness of order handling, market data and audit trails is critical. Special attention was paid to preserving invariants, improving integration points and making the codebase easier to evolve safely.
highlights: Incremental enhancements without disrupting existing behavior
Improved integration points with external systems
Strengthened auditability and traceability of changes
responsibilities: Analyzed and modified business functionality in an existing system
Improved integration points with external services
Preserved existing data-access and behavioral contracts
Improved maintainability of long-lived modules

projects.title: Japanese-Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) — Individual Form System
projects.description: Form management system supporting Individual applicants and registration/application workflows.
projects.longDescription: A form management system supporting the Japanese-Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) application process for Individual applicants. The system handles distinct application workflows per applicant type, manages form state across the registration lifecycle, and exposes a REST API consumed by the public-facing site at https://jlpt-maja.org.mm/. The design emphasizes correct applicant data handling, validation rules per applicant type and reliable submission workflows.
highlights: Validation rules tailored to each applicant type
REST API consumed by the public registration site
responsibilities: Designed form management workflows for Individual applicants
Implemented REST APIs backing the public registration site
Modeled validation rules per applicant type
Maintained auditable submission lifecycle

projects.title: Examiner Allocation System
projects.description: System for managing and allocating examiners to examination activities based on examination requirements and examiner information.
projects.longDescription: A management system for organizing and allocating examiners to examination activities. The system maintains examiner information and examination requirements, then produces allocations that respect constraints such as availability, capacity and conflict rules. The backend exposes a REST API used by administrators to manage examiners, examinations and allocations, and to track allocation status over time. The goal is to reduce manual coordination effort and provide a clear, auditable allocation process.
responsibilities: Designed examiner and examination data models
Implemented allocation workflow with constraint awareness
Exposed REST APIs for administrator operations
Maintained allocation history for audit

projects.title: SMS Migration
projects.description: Modernization of a legacy Java application while preserving business logic and existing data-access behavior.
projects.longDescription: A modernization engagement on a legacy Java SMS application. The objective was to migrate the application to a more maintainable stack while preserving existing business logic and data-access behavior. The migration incrementally moved functionality from a JSF / PrimeFaces front-end and MyBatis persistence layer toward Spring Boot and Jakarta EE conventions, without rewriting years of accumulated business rules. The work prioritized behavioral parity, low-risk incremental migration and improved maintainability for future changes.
highlights: Reduced legacy surface area over time
responsibilities: Migrated legacy modules toward Spring Boot incrementally
Preserved existing data-access behavior during migration
Reduced reliance on legacy JSF / PrimeFaces components
Maintained behavioral parity for end users

projects.title: Payment Gateway Integration
projects.description: Secure payment integration supporting authenticated APIs, transaction processing, callback handling and webhook processing.
projects.longDescription: A payment gateway integration supporting authenticated API access, transaction processing, callback handling and webhook processing. The integration exposes a clean internal API for initiating payments, while delegating to the gateway for the actual money flow. Special attention is paid to security (authentication, signature verification), reliability (idempotency, retries) and observability (per-transaction audit trail). The system is designed to integrate safely into larger platforms such as the FTTH Billing System.
highlights: Callback and webhook handling with signature verification
responsibilities: Designed and implemented the payment integration API
Handled callbacks and webhook signature verification
Implemented idempotent transaction processing
Maintained per-transaction audit trail

projects.title: AI Chatbot
projects.description: AI-powered conversational application integrating an open-source language model through REST API.
projects.longDescription: An AI-powered conversational application integrating an open-source language model through a REST API. The backend manages conversation context, exposes a clean API for the front-end, and proxies requests to the underlying model. The integration focuses on a clean backend contract, sensible defaults for prompts and responses, and the ability to swap the underlying model without breaking the front-end. The front-end is intentionally minimal — a JavaScript interface that talks to the Spring Boot backend.
highlights: Backend abstraction over an open-source LLM
responsibilities: Designed the chatbot backend API
Integrated an open-source LLM through REST
Managed conversation context
Built a minimal JavaScript front-end
